research_question: When selected high-fidelity pages are charged for their ranking effect on every query, does any set of at most 5% Omni pages have positive marginal workload nDCG and recover most Full-stack gain above BM25 plus ColSmol?

retrieval.partial_semantics: Selected Omni pages retain complete-index Top-100 ranks before RRF. This remains non-deployable global-rank accounting.
retrieval.full_reference: Equal-weight RRF60 over BM25 Top-100, ColSmol Top-100, and complete Omni Top-100.

selection_policies.greedy_marginal_ndcg_oracle: Starting from BM25 plus ColSmol, iteratively add the Omni page with the largest positive mean nDCG@10 change over the complete future workload. Each candidate is evaluated on every query where it appears in Omni Top-100, including negative cross-query interference. Stops when no positive marginal page remains; forbidden to a deployable method.
selection_policies.v0_policies: Random, uniform, physical risk, Omni frequency, residual-label, and global-label curves remain in the v0 artifact and are not overwritten.

greedy_oracle.warning: Greedy is a strong future-information lower bound, not a proof of globally optimal subset selection. Failure is evidence against easy headroom, not a mathematical impossibility proof.

cross_fit.history_policy: Unchanged from v0; v1 does not design an online policy.

gain_recovery: (Q_partial - Q_base) / (Q_full_stack - Q_base); undefined when Full-stack absolute gain is below 0.005.

cost_accounting.semantics: Measured-total linear projection from completed RTX 5090 builds.

gate.decision: Static oracle headroom requires both domains to recover at least 70% Full-stack gain and residual repair within 5%. Persistent online promotion additionally requires at least 20% history-to-future event overlap; report static and persistence gates separately.

information_boundary.warning: v1 is a corrective exploratory audit prompted by v0's non-monotonic interference, not a held-out result.
